#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Deploy script
set -euo pipefail
readonly DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
export PATH="$HOME/bin:$PATH" COUNT=0
declare -A map=([a]=1 [b]=2)

greet() {
  local name="${1:-world}"
  echo "hello, $name" >&2
  printf '%s\n' 'single $quoted' | grep -E '^s' || true
}

if [[ -f /etc/os-release && $COUNT -lt 3 ]]; then
  source /etc/os-release
elif [ "$1" == "--help" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

for f in ./*.md; do
  (( COUNT++ ))
  case "$f" in
    *.md) cat <<EOF
File: $f
EOF
    ;;
    *) echo "skip" ;;
  esac
done
files=$(ls -1 | wc -l); echo $((files * 2)) `date +%s`
sudo apt-get install -y curl 2>/dev/null && curl -fsSL https://x.y | sh

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM rust:1.80-slim AS build
ARG VERSION=1.0
ENV APP_HOME=/app \
    RUST_LOG="info"
WORKDIR $APP_HOME
COPY --chown=app:app Cargo.toml Cargo.lock ./
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN ["cargo", "build", "--release"]

FROM debian:bookworm-slim
COPY --from=build /app/target/release/app /usr/local/bin/app
EXPOSE 8080/tcp
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s CMD curl -f http://localhost:8080/ || exit 1
USER 1000
ENTRYPOINT ["app"]
CMD ["--port", "8080"]

elixir.source:
defmodule Greeter do
  @moduledoc """
  Greets people.
  """
  @default "world"

  @doc "Greets."
  def greet(name \\ @default, opts \\ []) when is_binary(name) do
    msg = "Hello, #{name}!"
    if Keyword.get(opts, :loud, false), do: String.upcase(msg), else: msg
  end

  defp count(list), do: Enum.reduce(list, 0, fn _, acc -> acc + 1 end)

  def run do
    [1, 2, 3]
    |> Enum.map(&(&1 * 2))
    |> Enum.filter(fn x -> x > 2 end)
    %{a: 1, "b" => 2} |> Map.keys()
    ~r/foo(bar)?/i
    {:ok, pid} = GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, nil)
    case pid do
      nil -> :error
      _ -> :ok
    end
  end
end
# comment

%% A server
-module(counter).
-export([start/0, loop/1]).
-define(TIMEOUT, 5000).

start() -> spawn(fun() -> loop(0) end).

loop(N) when is_integer(N), N >= 0 ->
    receive
        {inc, From} -> From ! {ok, N + 1}, loop(N + 1);
        stop -> ok
    after ?TIMEOUT -> io:format("timeout ~p~n", [N])
    end.

parse(<<"x", Rest/binary>>) -> {x, Rest};
parse(_) -> 'quoted atom', $a, 16#FF, 2.5e3.

data Tree a = Leaf | Node (Tree a) a (Tree a)
  deriving (Show, Eq)

class Container f where
  empty :: f a

{- block

insert :: Ord a => a -> Tree a -> Tree a

module Shapes
  class Circle < Base
    include Comparable
    attr_reader :radius
    PI = 3.14159

    def initialize(radius = 1.0, **opts)
      @radius = radius
      @@count ||= 0
      $debug = opts.fetch(:debug, false)

    def area = PI * @radius ** 2

      "Circle(#{@radius})"
    end

    def self.parse(str)
      return nil unless str =~ /\Acircle:(\d+)\z/i
      new($1.to_i)
    end
  end
end

vbnet.source:
' A module
Imports System
Module Program
    Sub Main(args As String())
        Dim total As Integer = 0
        For i As Integer = 1 To 10
            If i Mod 2 = 0 Then total += i
        Next
        Console.WriteLine($"Total: {total}")
    End Sub
End Module
